description:
Brian is a boy who lost his only family member, his older brother, to the war. He volunteers for the unit his older brother served in after seeing a recruitment notice for the euthanasia of wounded soldiers who could not receive proper treatment. Dern, a soldier who was close to Brian's older brother, feels complicated emotions when he hears that Brian has come to kill his comrades... In the midst of the rapidly changing battlefield, the relationship between the two becomes entangled.

**Original Webtoon:**
